member.name: M:GridKrafter.Models.WidgetColors.CustomColor
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^(#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}|(rgb|rgba|hsl|hsla|hwb|lab|lch|oklab|oklch)\\([0-9a-zA-Z.,%/\\s+-]{1,80}\\))$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ 1st capture group.
○ Match with 2 alternative expressions.
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Match '#'.
○ Match a hexadecimal digit atomically at least 3 and at most 8 times.
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ 2nd capture group.
○ Match with 4 alternative expressions.
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Match the string "rgb".
○ Match 'a' atomically, optionally.
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Match 'h'.
○ Match with 2 alternative expressions.
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Match the string "sl".
○ Match 'a' atomically, optionally.
○ Match the string "wb".
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Match 'l'.
○ Match with 2 alternative expressions.
○ Match the string "ab".
○ Match the string "ch".
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Match the string "okl".
○ Match with 2 alternative expressions.
○ Match the string "ab".
○ Match the string "ch".
○ Match '('.
○ Match a character in the set [%+-9A-Za-z\s] atomically at least 1 and at most 80 times.
○ Match ')'.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.
